purpose: Pre-registered tolerance-margin (eta) LTT study (ICTExpress-v1). Fixed before any data of this study are generated. Everything except the decision rule, the seeds and the test-seed offset is taken unchanged from the 10-s protocol (horizon_config.json + confirm_config.json).
seed_reason: new seeds; seed mod 1000 differs from every earlier seed (101..229, 503..661, 701..857), so no data stream of an earlier study is reused
rule: apply candidate c (post-hoc correction c* chosen on C_s1, or the retrained model fitted with C_s2 held out) iff u(k_eta, n, eps) <= delta, where k_eta = #{i in C_s2 : L_i(c) > (1 + eta) L_i(Z)} and u is the one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bound
guarantee: with C_s2 i.i.d. from the test distribution and c independent of C_s2: with probability >= 1 - eps, P(L(c) > (1 + eta) L(Z)) <= delta for an applied c (eta-level deterioration). Strict deterioration (eta = 0) is NOT controlled for eta > 0 and is reported separately.
retrain_definition: same as confirm_r2.py: residual MLP refitted on train + calibration episodes (judge set held out), same epochs/patience/hidden/lr as Z

claims.E1_validity: eta = 0.05, ID test, applied runs pooled per target: the episode-level eta-exceedance rate has a one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound <= delta (0.1). Supported if it holds for both targets with at least one applied run; otherwise not_supported (a target with no applied run is reported as inconclusive).
claims.E2_usefulness: retraining target: applied runs at eta = 0.05 minus applied runs at eta = 0 >= min_effect_runs (8 of 80 = 10%). Supported / not_supported.
claims.E3_cost: descriptive: ID net gain and strict episode-level deterioration of the eta = 0.05 rule vs the eta = 0 rule for both targets (seed-cluster bootstrap 95% CI, B = 2000).
claims.E4_shift: descriptive: under the damping shift, number of applied runs that are worse than Z (run-level MSE) for every eta and target.

multiplicity: one primary eta and two primary claims (E1, E2); sensitivity etas are reported as sensitivity, not as separate confirmatory tests
stopping: all 80 runs are executed; no early stopping; a failed run is reported as missing, never as 0
